Purpose: Align strategy, capabilities, change and governance across the whole organisation.
Scope: Vision, principles, capability map, roadmap, governance, repository, architecture practice.
Key artefacts: Architecture vision; principles catalogue; capability map; roadmap; governance model
TOGAF ADM phases: Preliminary, A, E, F, G, H

Purpose: Describe what the organisation does: capabilities, value streams, processes, rules, organisation and information needs.
Scope: Business model, value streams, capabilities, processes, business rules, stakeholders, requirements.
Key artefacts: Capability map; value stream; process catalogue; business rules; requirements

Purpose: Define how data is modelled, owned, governed, secured, integrated and used for decisions.
Scope: Conceptual and logical data model, dictionary, quality rules, master and reference data, metadata, lifecycle.
Key artefacts: Data entities; data dictionary; DQ rules; DMBOK area targets

Purpose: Define the applications and components that deliver business capabilities, and how they fit together.
Scope: Component model, services, application portfolio, building blocks, solution design.
Key artefacts: Component catalogue; ABB/SBB list; context and layered diagrams

Purpose: Define the technology platforms, standards and services that applications and data run on.
Scope: Technology standards, platforms, services, patterns, lifecycle of technology choices.
Key artefacts: Technology standards; platform services; decision records

Purpose: Define when and how machine learning, analytics and generative AI are used responsibly.
Scope: Use-case selection, model lifecycle, data readiness, human oversight, evaluation, AI risk and ethics.
Key artefacts: AI use-case register; model lifecycle; AI principles; evaluation criteria

Purpose: Protect information, services and people: identity, access, privacy, resilience, assurance.
Scope: Security principles, classification, access model, controls, threat and risk view, audit trail.
Key artefacts: Classification scheme; access matrix; controls; security risks

Purpose: Design how people experience the solution: journeys, interfaces, accessibility, content and feedback.
Scope: Personas, journeys, interaction patterns, accessibility, design system, usability testing.
Key artefacts: Personas; journey map; UX standards; accessibility criteria

Purpose: Provide the hosting, networks, compute, storage, resilience and operations the solution runs on.
Scope: Environments, hosting options, networks, capacity, availability, disaster recovery, operations.
Key artefacts: Environment and hosting model; availability targets; capacity plan

Purpose: Connect systems, partners and data reliably: interfaces, APIs, events, messaging and exchange standards.
Scope: Interface catalogue, integration patterns, API standards, data exchange, interoperability.
Key artefacts: Interface catalogue; integration patterns; API standards

Purpose: Capture domain-specific rules, vocabulary and reference content for one functional area, for example network operations or regulation.
Scope: Domain reference models, rules, glossaries, standards, domain-specific building blocks.
Key artefacts: Domain glossary; business rules; domain reference model

Purpose: Apply sector-level reference models, regulation, standards and practices so the architecture fits the industry and country.
Scope: Industry reference architectures, regulatory obligations, country configuration, sector patterns.
Key artefacts: Regulatory obligations; country profile; industry reference mapping
